cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D2 and D3 in docs. (1) skills/bee-hive/references/onboarding.md: add a section `## Set up the project's checks` after Workspace protocol. When: the user asks to set up lint, type check, tests, or the verify or CI commands, at any time. Steps: 1. Run `.bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --json` and read its notices for detected checks and candidates; read `bee config explain --key commands.test` for what is recorded. 2. With a check found, run it once and tell the user green or the finding count. 3. With no linter in the project, name the stack's usual linter (eslint, ruff, clippy, golangci-lint, phpcs and so on), and after the user agrees add it to the project as a dev dependency with its config through the normal bee chain for a code change. 4. Write the list yourself: `.bee/bin/bee config set --key commands.test --value '["<lint>","<typecheck>","<tests>"]'` — checks first, then the existing test entries, keeping every entry already there. The user's set-up request is the confirmation (lint-setup-guidance D2). 5. Log the answer with `bee decisions log`. Rules: `commands` is the agent's to write; never answer that permission is missing; never hand-edit `.bee/config.json`; only team, herding.agents, herding.agent_command and hooks are the user's to edit. (2) skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md: in the reference table row for references/onboarding.md, add that it also loads when the user asks to set up lint, type check, tests or verify commands (section Set up the project's checks); keep the line short. (3) host-project-artifacts.md section 'Static checks are offered as members of `commands.test`': add that the notices name bee config set (commands.test) and that a user set-up request is the confirmation, citing lint-setup-guidance D1 and D2 (history D-numbers, never raw ids), and point to the new onboarding.md section. Run `bee knowledge check` after. (4) Run `bee dev regen` so the rendered skill trees, onboarding ledger, skills lock and release manifest follow; restore any hub-served skill under .claude/skills that regen re-rendered and that this cell does not own. Plain English, no code comments. Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts.
